headline: Hapvida Hires Investment Banks to Re-evaluate Asset Portfolio
summary: Brazilian healthcare provider Hapvida confirmed it has hired investment banks to advise on re-evaluating its asset portfolio, responding to queries from securities regulator CVM.
why: Hapvida is Brazil's largest private healthcare operator, and portfolio divestments or reorganizations can significantly alter leverage and EBITDA margins.

impacts.name: Hapvida
impacts.why: Hired investment banking advisors to review asset divestment and strategic options.
